children: Saudi-listed Edarat Communication and Information Technology (EDARAT) will invest SAR 150 million ($39.94 million) to expand its cloud infrastructure platform amid strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing services.
The major capital expansion plan to scale up the “EdaratCloud Stack” received approval from the board of directors on Wednesday, the firm said in a disclosure to the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul).
With the plan, the information technology services provider seeks to boost its GPU computing capacity across the Kingdom.
“The investment will be implemented through purchase orders and/or contracts, as applicable,” said Edarat, which specialises in data centre consultancy, cloud hosting services and IT infrastructure.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) Seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Saudi IT firm Edarat to invest nearly $40mln amid strong demand for AI services
